sql:
SELECT c.artist, l.format
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l.uuid = c.uuid
WHERE c.artist IS NOT NULL
  AND c.artist <> ''
  AND c.artist IN (
    SELECT artist
    FROM cards
    WHERE artist IS NOT NULL AND artist <> ''
    GROUP BY artist
    HAVING COUNT(*) = (
      SELECT MIN(card_count)
      FROM (
        SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_count
        FROM cards
        WHERE artist IS NOT NULL AND artist <> ''
        GROUP BY artist
      )
    )
  )
GROUP BY c.artist, l.format
ORDER BY c.artist, l.format
